title: Slow-Braised Beef Brisket
subtitle: Low-and-slow oven-braised brisket with smoky tomato sauce
excerpt: Brisket needs long, slow cooking in liquid to become tender. This version braises in a smoky tomato and vegetable sauce that reduces into a rich gravy.
sourceNotes: Combines American BBQ braising principles with British pot-roast technique. The smoke comes from smoked paprika rather than a smoker.

recipe.freezeNotes: Slice and freeze with the sauce in portions for up to 3 months.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Brisket is even better the next day. Cool and refrigerate overnight, then reheat gently in the sauce.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 130 or gas 2. Low and slow.

content.text: Sear the brisket until deep brown on all sides before adding the liquid. That colour is where the flavour comes from.
Heat the oven to 150 degrees C. Pat the brisket dry and season generously on all sides.
Heat a splash of oil in the stockpot over high heat. Sear the brisket for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium. Add the onion to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, carrot, and celery. Cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree and smoked paprika. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tinned tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, and beef stock. Bring to a simmer.
Return the brisket to the pot. The liquid should come at least halfway up. Cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 3 hours 30 minutes until the meat pulls apart easily with a fork.
Rest for 20 minutes before slicing or pulling. Serve with the braising sauce.

items.symptom: Brisket is still tough after 3 hours.
items.cause: Oven temperature was too low or the cut was very thick.
items.fix: Cover and cook for another 45 minutes; check every 20 minutes.

items.symptom: Sauce is very thin and watery.
items.cause: Too much stock added or lid was too tight.
items.fix: Remove brisket and simmer sauce on the hob to reduce.

items.symptom: Brisket dried out in the pot.
items.cause: Not enough liquid or left uncovered in the oven.
items.fix: Always keep the lid on and add water if liquid drops below 2cm.
